title: Gorp Run Record
description: Durable, auditable record of one node run, assembled once by `gorp run` at the end of the run and never edited afterwards (append-only, hashed into the audit chain). finalStatus records the EXECUTION outcome (current runtime produces 'succeeded' or 'failed'); the later review verdict lives only in review-decision.schema.json and the promotion result only in promotion-record.schema.json. controlDecisions EXPLAINS the control steps, not merely the outputs.

governanceVersion.description: Resolved Gorp governance/doctrine version in force for this run.

sandboxIdentity.description: Opaque sandbox identifier (e.g. worktree branch). Not created in Wave A.

promotionResult.description: Unused by the current runtime: promotion is recorded in the separate immutable promotion-record.schema.json (the run record is never updated after the run ends). Retained for record-shape compatibility.

controlDecisions.description: Ordered record of WHY the run took each control step (the explanatory audit).

stateTransitions.description: Copies/refs of the transition records relevant to this run.

profile.description: Assembled worker profile stamped at dispatch (optional — only present when a persona is assigned).
